short_en: OceanFirst Financial Corp. (the “Company”) is incorporated under Delaware law and serves as the holding company for OceanFirst Bank N.A (the “Bank”). At December 31, 2025, the Company had consolidated total assets of $14.6 billion and total stockholders’ equity of $1.7 billion. The Company is subject to regulation by the Board of Governors of the FRB and the SEC. The Bank is primarily subject to regulation and supervision by the OCC, as well as the CFPB due to the Bank exceeding $10 billion in assets.
full_en: OceanFirst Financial Corp. (the “Company”) is incorporated under Delaware law and serves as the holding company for OceanFirst Bank N.A (the “Bank”). At December 31, 2025, the Company had consolidated total assets of $14.6 billion and total stockholders’ equity of $1.7 billion. The Company is subject to regulation by the Board of Governors of the FRB and the SEC. The Bank is primarily subject to regulation and supervision by the OCC, as well as the CFPB due to the Bank exceeding $10 billion in assets. The Bank is also subject to regulation and supervision by the FDIC, as its deposit insurer. Currently, the Company transacts the vast majority of its business through the Bank, its wholly owned subsidiary.

(ה-Company) משולב על פי חוק דלאוור ומשמש כחברת אחזקה עבור Ocean First Bank N.A (הבנק). ב-31 בדצמבר 2025 הוקמה החברה נכסים בסך של 14.6 מיליארד דולר והון הכולל של בעלי מניות של 1.7 מיליארד דולר. החברה כפופה לתקנה של מועצת המושלים של ה- FRB וה-SEC. הבנק כפוף בעיקר לרגולציה ופיקוח על ידי OCC, כמו גם CFPB בשל הבנק מעל 10 מיליארד דולר בנכסים. הבנק כפוף גם לרגולציה ופיקוח על ידי ה-FDIC, כפי שהפקדה שלו. כיום החברה מעבירה את רוב עסקיה באמצעות הבנק, חברת הבת שבבעלותה.
